cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.st: In 1928 a letter in the Capital Times said "no recovery was ever made"; Lesperance claimed the money was buried in the woods a short distance from Wabeno and staged fake show-the-spot trips. In August 1922 berry pickers found the rusted getaway car on an abandoned logging trail about 20 mi E of Wabeno and several miles W of Athelstane, in ground the earlier searches had not covered. Car spot is an inference; one dug-up empty cache was reported in 1921. (A rumored hiding place on the Chippewa River bank at Chippewa Falls, where the gang's weapons were found, is not pinned.)
